paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.06% on average, with Dow Jones strongest (+0.91%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-0.62%). Brent crude changed -0.47% to 109.03. Gold changed -0.53% to 4,138.0. Bitcoin changed +1.07% to 82,729.1328. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.132%, a relative move of -0.08%. Among the firms tracked, Jefferies (+3.47%) and Blackstone (+3.46%) moved the most.
